description: Turn Mermaid flowchart or graph syntax, or an indented outline, into FlowSimp links. Use it when the steps already exist as text and someone needs a diagram they can view or edit. Returns JSON with shareUrl (a read-only /view# link), editUrl (opens the editor at /?board=), nodeCount, and connectionCount. An optional title is echoed in that JSON; it is not drawn on a shape. The diagram is compressed into the link, so nothing is stored and the call does not write to a database. Only flowchart and graph syntax are accepted. Other Mermaid types are refused. Text is limited to 16,000 characters and about 80 shapes.

mode.description: Editor mode stored in the link. flowchart is the default. network opens the network editor instead. Parsing does not change with the mode.

text.description: Diagram source. A Mermaid flowchart or graph (flowchart TD, rectangles in [], diamonds in {}, edge labels such as -->|Yes|), or an indented outline with one step per line. A trailing question mark becomes a decision, and Yes: or No: becomes an arrow label. Required. Maximum 16,000 characters.

title.description: Optional label echoed in the JSON result. It is not placed on a shape and it is not stored.
